content.overview: If the agreed appointment machinery fails, the High Court or Supreme Court (or its designate) appoints. The court looks at existence of the agreement.
content.study: Do not turn a section 11 petition into a mini-trial on merits. Validity and scope go to the tribunal under 16. International commercial arbitration appointment sits in the Supreme Court.
